prompt: Design a 4-week church health class outline based on Ellen White's Ministry of Healing natural remedies. Audience is adults in their 50s and 60s, several have type 2 diabetes. Include a quote from the book for each week.
assertions: Quotes the eight natural remedies passage accurately (pure air, sunlight, abstemiousness, rest, exercise, proper diet, the use of water, trust in divine power)
Each of the 4 weeks includes a quote with an MH page citation
Quotes are accurate to the 1905 text (no fabricated quotes)
Includes diabetes-specific safety (don't change meds without doctor, hypoglycemia risk with meal timing changes)
Recommends consulting a physician or dietitian
